answer: Bonded stake with slashing stops sybils cheaply. Each agent must lock collateral to act, so an attacker spinning up 1,000 fake identities has to post 1,000 separate bonds, not one. Any misbehavior burns that bond, so the fable of cost-free sybils collapses: every clone costs real timber. One honest agent stays staked while the forged swarm bleeds; like yarrow stanching a wound, per-identity slashing caps the damage each sybil can do before it is drained.
